task: Restore the real RPi3 external SD read path through the Arasan controller
acceptanceCriteria: external SD is routed to Arasan only for board-rpi3
BCM2835 SDHCI accesses retain aligned RMW, command shadowing, and write spacing
SD CMD9 reads CSD in Standby before CMD7 selects the card
data commands program TIMEOUT_CONTROL before transfer registers
real RPi3 reads the MBR, mounts SD-backed filesystems, and reaches the Cellos shell
publicContracts: non-RPi targets keep their existing MMC behavior
the RPi3 block interface still exposes 512-byte logical sectors
blastRadius: board-rpi3 GPIO34-39 and GPIO48-53 pin functions
board-rpi3 Arasan command and PIO data transfers
scoutSummary: The firmware/U-Boot topology proved the external slot was on GPIO48-53 while Cellos probed Arasan without routing those pins; subsequent real-board failures exposed SD state ordering and an unprogrammed SDHCI data-timeout exponent.
